scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @currents/api" "npm run dev -w @currents/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @currents/shared && npm run build -w @currents/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @currents/api && npm run test -w @currents/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @currents/api && npm run test:coverage -w @currents/web
